verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a documented REST API with machine-to-machine OAuth (Client Credentials Grant), so scripts can launch and bulk-launch workflows, trigger export jobs and push approvals without the UI, which supports unattended automation. There is no CLI or CI-specific tooling, the API is a paid add-on, and some setup (publishing workflows in Workflow Designer) still happens in the UI. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, fully UI-free setup (workflow publishing requires Workflow Designer), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
